method: sorted non-README .txt/.md files, non-heading blank-line paragraphs >=200characters, uniform random.Random choice
passage: People tried PCA, t-SNE, different kinds of autoencoders and neural networks, and searches for categorical features hidden among columns with few distinct values. Some tried to find a time-series structure, perhaps by identifying Unix timestamps and converting them into weeks or other time units. None of those ideas really worked.
interpretation: Anonymous column relationships can tempt unsupported temporal stories. Test held-out target utility rather than assuming corresponding indices have an economic meaning. This static competition failure does not refute a causal stream mechanism.
